A '''restraint collar''' or '''pain collar'''<ref name="Blaze">{{JournalCite|8|Blaze of Glory (short story)}}</ref> was a restraining device. They could be fitted to [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and prohibited their movement. The collar, typically toroidal in shape, would fit around the legs of a droid and, in the case of wheeled droids, held their weight off the floor to prevent the wheels gaining traction.<ref name="HttE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> Restraint collars were also used to keep control of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].<ref name="Blaze" />
